# hyperlite_backup_job (Resource)

A grouped backup job: every VM it selects, on one schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every VM tagged `prod`, but one, every night to a NAS mount.
resource "hyperlite_backup_job" "prod" {
  name            = "prod-nightly"
  selection       = "tag"
  value           = "prod"
  excluded        = ["scratch-1"]
  frequency       = "daily"
  time            = "01:00"
  target_dir      = "/mnt/nas/backups"
  retention_count = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `frequency` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.
- `name` (String) Its name.
- `selection` (String) The VMs it backs up: `all`, those with a `tag`, or those of a `pool`.
- `time` (String) The time of the run, `HH:MM`, on the node's clock.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Runs on its schedule.
- `excluded` (Set of String) VMs left out, by name.
- `keep_days` (Number) GFS retention: the last backup of each of the last N days.
- `keep_months` (Number) GFS retention: the last backup of each of the last N months.
- `keep_weeks` (Number) GFS retention: the last backup of each of the last N weeks.
- `retention_count` (Number) The newest backups kept, besides those a GFS rule keeps.
- `target_dir` (String) Where the backups go (an absolute path); absent: the node's default directory, which the server reports.
- `value` (String) The tag, or the pool's id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The job's id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id.
terraform import hyperlite_backup_job.prod 3
```
